mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads brought the earlier cell parts together and connected their arrangement to muscle shortening. The paired poses help explain the mechanism, though their clarity as finished illustrations remains untested.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the nuclei was straightforward progress, but its result alone added less explanation than the later ribosome and mitochondrion results.

surprise.text: I expected membrane fats to combine with water first; the compatibility feedback instead showed that transport proteins were needed to make the selective membrane.

arbitrary.text: The initial membrane pairing was not obvious to me from the titles and pictures alone, although the resulting channel picture gave it a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how these muscle fibers become tissue and work with other body systems. The final construction gave me a reason to follow that progression.
